label: copy phase, fed-back input m (or g), mid/late recall
explanation: Active only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the <DEL> step), and only from recall_idx 2 on, peaking around recall_idx 3-5 (t 11-13). It is driven mostly by the fed-back input token: m (15x lift, 59% of activation mass, every top example is an m input) and g (6.6x, 20% of mass), with weaker contributions from j, k, b, 3. Activations on m are much larger than on g or other tokens. Always on a repeated input (in_first=0, which follows from the copy phase). It does NOT fire on m/g in the original phase. Many m/g inputs in the copy phase stay inactive, especially at the last output step, and no simple history variable separates them, so precision is about 0.35 and the threshold looks like it depends on hidden state. Prev token b or w is somewhat enriched in the top examples, but conditioning on it did not help.
